payload.description_html: Carinasquama rusmithii holotype, NMS G.2022.2.1, showing details of the integument. A. Dorsal view of the specimen, showing the head and back scales; B. Ventral view, at the level of the cloaca, showing the hemipenal bulge; C. Details of the multi-carinated scales: D. Ventral view of the tail with imbricated scales.
